defects.title: Raw backing map exposed via H6FieldAccess.data
defects.root_cause: H6FieldAccess is @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) with a `data` field. Because slots=True creates a real slot descriptor, normal attribute lookup for `data` succeeds and the class __getattr__ guard that raises AttributeError for the name 'data' is DEAD CODE. `wrapped.data['count_long_short_ratio']` therefore retrieves a forbidden provider field.

defects.title: repr / str / copy / pickle / backing-object leakage of forbidden values
defects.root_cause: The dataclass-generated __repr__ renders the whole payload including forbidden field names AND values; copy.copy and pickle round-trips carry the same raw backing mapping because forbidden values were retained in memory.
defects.evidence: verifier: 5 MEDIUM leaks observed; repr/str/format + copy.copy + pickle all leaked all four forbidden names
defects.impact: logs, tracebacks and evidence dumps are evidence surfaces; forbidden feature values must never reach them

defects.title: Whitelist not on the actual H6 runtime data path
defects.root_cause: Whole-src scan: the only files referencing H6FieldAccess / check_row_whitelist / assert_field_allowed are whitelist.py itself and the h6/__init__.py re-export. No OI-reading module (feature_engine, eligibility, oi_dataset_v2, data loaders) invokes the accessor.
defects.consequence: the control existed but provided no runtime guarantee; feature authority was enforced only by the normaliser stripping forbidden columns and by static scans

defects.title: build_completed_hour_oi fails for non-empty snapshots (.start/.end on a tuple)
defects.root_cause: src/trading_bot/research/h6/eligibility.py::build_completed_hour_oi does `ts_to_use = _hour_close_boundaries(hour_close_time)` where that helper returns a plain TUPLE, then accesses `ts_to_use.start` / `ts_to_use.end` -> AttributeError for any non-empty snapshot list. With an EMPTY list the predicate is never evaluated, so the function appears to work exactly in the vacuous case.
defects.evidence: verifier: minimal reproduction — build_completed_hour_oi([], ...) -> OK; build_completed_hour_oi([one_snapshot], ...) -> AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'start'
defects.reachability: no runtime caller (only the h6/__init__.py re-export)

defects.title: Inclusive hour-window bounds can produce 13 snapshots instead of 12
defects.root_cause: build_completed_hour_oi selects `start <= s.oi_time <= end` (INCLUSIVE on both ends). The frozen grid is 5 minutes aligned to :00, so an hour ending at T contains 13 points in [T-1h, T] but exactly 12 in the required half-open [T-1h, T). The eligibility helper _snapshots_in_window_v2 and SNAPSHOTS_PER_HOUR = 12 both use half-open semantics, so the inclusive variant would make snapshot_count != 12 and always fail CURRENT_HOUR_OI_COMPLETENESS even after V3-FEATURE-001 is fixed.
defects.evidence: verifier: half-open vs inclusive analysis in VERIFIER_EVIDENCE_pit_nonvacuous.md; verifier harness had to use half-open [T-1h, T) to reach 12 snapshots and an ELIGIBLE state
